page.about.about-angles: Angles is an open-source dashboard which can be used to store results and screenshots for automated test runs from various frameworks.
page.about.about-api: By providing a clearly defined {apiLink} any framework can be adapted to store its test result in Angles, using one of the clients provided (or by using the API directly)

page.admin.settings.provider.name.help: Shown on the login button, for example "Company SSO".
page.admin.settings.provider.id.help: 2-32 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens. Forms part of the callback URL and cannot be changed later.
page.admin.settings.provider.id.help-loc: The ID forms part of the callback URL registered with the identity provider and cannot be changed.
page.admin.settings.provider.type.help-l: The provider type cannot be changed after it has been created.
page.admin.settings.provider.enabled.hel: Offer this provider on the login page.
page.admin.settings.provider.callback-ur: Register this URL with your identity provider.
page.admin.settings.provider.default-rol: Role granted when no mapping matches. Deny access is the safer default.
page.admin.settings.provider.secret.help: A value is configured. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new value to replace it.
Once saved this value cannot be viewed again.
page.admin.settings.provider.error.id: The provider ID must be 2-32 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
page.admin.settings.provider.error.dupli: Another provider already uses this ID.

page.admin.settings.oidc.title: OIDC Configuration
page.admin.settings.oidc.issuer.help: Endpoints and signing keys are discovered from the issuer’s .well-known/openid-configuration.
page.admin.settings.oidc.scopes.help: Space-separated. "openid" is always added. Okta and Keycloak accept "groups"; Google rejects it.
page.admin.settings.oidc.groups-claim.he: Claim holding group membership — "groups" for Okta, often "roles" for Keycloak. Entra ID reports group GUIDs.
Claim used as the Angles username. Falls back to email, preferred_username, then sub.
page.admin.settings.saml.title: SAML 2.0 Configuration
page.admin.settings.saml.metadata-url.he: Import this into your identity provider instead of entering values by hand.
page.admin.settings.saml.entry-point.hel: The identity provider URL the browser is redirected to.
page.admin.settings.saml.idp-cert.help: Required — it is the only reason an assertion can be trusted. Accepted with or without PEM header lines.
page.admin.settings.saml.issuer.help: This service provider’s entity ID, as registered with the identity provider.
page.admin.settings.saml.private-key.hel: Only needed when the identity provider requires signed authentication requests. Leave blank to keep the stored key.
page.admin.settings.saml.username-attrib: Assertion attribute holding the username. Leave blank to use the Name ID.
page.admin.settings.saml.response-signed: Turn off for identity providers that sign only the assertion. Assertion signatures are always required.
page.admin.settings.saml.allow-unsolicit: Off by default: an unsolicited assertion has no request to correlate against, which removes its replay protection.
page.admin.settings.ldap.title: LDAP / Active Directory Configuration
page.admin.settings.ldap.url.help: Use ldaps://, or ldap:// with StartTLS. A plain ldap:// connection is refused because passwords would be sent in clear text.
page.admin.settings.ldap.bind-dn.help: Service account used to look up the user. Leave blank for an anonymous search.
page.admin.settings.ldap.search-filter.h: {username} is replaced with the submitted username. Active Directory usually uses (sAMAccountName={username}).
page.admin.settings.ldap.username-attrib: Attribute used as the Angles username — "uid", or "sAMAccountName" on Active Directory.
page.admin.settings.ldap.group-search-ba: Leave blank to read group membership from the user’s memberOf attribute, as Active Directory usually exposes it.
page.admin.settings.ldap.group-name-attr: Full DNs are reduced to this attribute, so map roles to names such as "Angles Admins".
page.admin.settings.ldap.start-tls.help: Upgrade a plain ldap:// connection to TLS.
page.admin.settings.ldap.tls-reject-unau: Turning this off makes the connection trivially interceptable. Only for self-signed lab setups.
page.admin.settings.role-mappings.title: Group to Role Mapping
page.admin.settings.role-mappings.help: Map groups reported by the provider onto Angles roles. Matching is case-insensitive, and a user matching several mappings is granted the strongest role (Admin > Team Lead > User).
page.admin.settings.role-mappings.empty: No mappings yet. Without one, access depends on the default role below.
